resources.string: Synthetic test file only. Financial data stays on this phone. Each phone creates one test file in its own Google Drive and shares it with the other phone. Google Cloud setup is required before connecting.

Use a different Google account on each phone. Finish each step on both phones before the next one:
1. Connect Google account.
2. Create my test file. Copy my file ID and send it to the other phone yourself.
3. Enter the other phone’s Google email, then Share my test file.
4. Paste the other phone’s file ID, then Grant access to the other file. Select the only file shown.
5. Read the other phone’s file. The result shows its phone code and write number.
6. Phone 1: Update my test file. Phone 2: Read the other phone’s file again. Version and write number must grow. Repeat the other way round.
7. Phone 1: Send test request. Phone 2: Read my requests (one from the other phone must be listed), then Remove the received request. Phone 1: Read the other phone’s file. The result must show “my request on other file: none”. Repeat the other way round.
8. Force-stop and reopen the app, then repeat step 5 without granting again.
If a step fails, report its number and the error code.
Grant access to the other file
Test failed or cancelled. Check Google Cloud setup, account access and connection, then retry.
